title: Deciphering Hate: Identifying Hateful Memes and Their Targets
findings: The paper introduces a new dataset (BHM) for hateful Bengali memes which includes religion as a target category for hate. Examples of hate speech targeting Muslims and definitions including Buddhism are provided. The proposed model, DORA, outperforms existing models in identifying these hateful memes and their targets, including those based on religion, but no specific quantitative findings about religious hate are detailed separately from other categories.
